kits.desc: A golf hole: tee at your feet, mown fairway, green with a flag and a real hole, bunkers, trees
kits.greeting: Welcome to the first tee. The green is straight ahead.

kits.desc: A downtown street grid: you stand at a crossroads between blocks of towers, with lamps, cars and lit windows at night
kits.greeting: The city never sleeps. Look up.

kits.desc: A deep woodland: mixed trees all around, a clearing where you stand, ferns, mushrooms, logs, deer
kits.greeting: Deep in the woods. Listen.

kits.desc: A sandy shore: sea ahead, palms behind, parasols, deck chairs, a sandcastle, boats on the water
kits.greeting: Sand under your feet, sea ahead.

kits.desc: A small desert island ringed by sea: palms, a treasure chest, a rowing boat, crabs
kits.greeting: Your own island. Nobody for miles.

kits.desc: A wide desert: cacti, wind-carved rock spires, bleached bones, a great pyramid on the horizon
kits.greeting: Nothing but sand and sky.

kits.desc: The surface of the Moon: craters, a lander, a rocket, astronauts, the Earth hanging in a black sky, low gravity
kits.greeting: One small step. Things fall slowly here.

kits.desc: Floating in open space on a small platform: asteroids drifting past, planets, a satellite, no gravity
kits.greeting: Nothing holds you down out here.

kits.desc: A snowy village: log cabins with lit windows, snow-laden pines, snowmen, a decorated tree
kits.greeting: Snow is falling. The cabins are warm.

kits.desc: Under the sea: coral, swaying kelp, schools of fish, jellyfish, a turtle, a sunken chest
kits.greeting: Deep breath. You're under the sea.

kits.desc: A working farm: red barn, windmill, fenced field of animals, hay bales, a scarecrow
kits.greeting: Morning on the farm.

kits.desc: A stone castle: walls and corner towers around a courtyard, a gatehouse facing you, knights, torches
kits.greeting: The gates are open. Welcome to the castle.

kits.desc: A timber-framed village around a square: houses, a well, market torches, villagers
kits.greeting: The village square, just before dusk.

kits.desc: A serene garden: red torii gate, pagoda, cherry trees in blossom, stone lanterns, a bridge over a pond
kits.greeting: Petals on the wind. Take your time.

kits.desc: A retro-future highway: glowing grid to the horizon, a huge low sun, neon palms, purple mountains
kits.greeting: Welcome to 1986. Sort of.

kits.desc: A campsite at night: tent, crackling fire ringed with logs, lantern, pines, fireflies
kits.greeting: Pull up a log. The fire's going.

kits.desc: A haunted graveyard: crooked headstones, bare trees, a mansion on the hill, drifting ghosts, bats
kits.greeting: Something moved. Probably the wind.

kits.desc: A night-time street under attack: wrecked cars, a barricade to stand behind, and a horde that keeps coming at you and falls when shot or hit. Zombies unless params says otherwise. Density sets how many. Give the user a blaster to go with it

params.enemy: any character or animal asset id: zombie (default), robot, alien, skeleton, knight, t_rex ...

kits.greeting: They're coming. Grab the blaster and pull the trigger.

kits.desc: A maze to find your way out of: solid walls you cannot walk through, you start in the middle, and a flag marks the way out. Size sets how big (7 to 15 cells across)
kits.greeting: You're in the middle. The flag is the way out.

kits.desc: A land made of sweets: giant lollipops, candy canes, cupcakes, doughnuts and a towering cake
kits.greeting: Everything here is edible. Probably.

kits.desc: Ruins of a forgotten temple: rows of marble columns, broken arches, statues, an obelisk
kits.greeting: Somebody built this three thousand years ago.

kits.desc: A park playground: swings, a slide, a seesaw, a trampoline, benches, trees, balls to kick about
kits.greeting: Go on. Nobody's watching.

kits.desc: A bright white gallery: framed paintings all around, sculptures on plinths, an easel and paints beside you
kits.greeting: The gallery is yours. Pick up a brush.

kits.desc: An outdoor court: basketball hoop ahead with balls at your feet, a football goal behind, court lines
kits.greeting: Ball's at your feet. Take the shot.

kits.desc: A bowling lane: polished wood running ahead to ten pins, bowling balls beside you
kits.greeting: Ten pins, twelve metres. Grab a ball.

kits.desc: A prehistoric valley: giant ferns and palms, a towering long-neck, a T. rex, a smoking volcano
kits.greeting: Sixty-five million years ago. Stay still.

kits.desc: African savanna: golden grass, flat-topped trees, elephants, giraffes and lions in the distance
kits.greeting: Golden hour on the savanna.

kits.desc: A funfair at dusk: a giant Ferris wheel, striped tents, balloons, lights, a crowd
kits.greeting: Roll up. The wheel's turning.

kits.desc: A quiet harbour: a wooden pier, boats at anchor, a lighthouse, crates and barrels on the quay
kits.greeting: Tide's in. Boats are ready.

kits.desc: A Wild West main street: saloons on both sides, cacti, barrels, horses, tumbleweed blowing through
kits.greeting: This town ain't big enough.

kits.desc: A volcanic wasteland: black rock, rivers of glowing lava, burnt trees, an erupting cone, falling embers
kits.greeting: Mind the lava.

kits.desc: Above the clouds: a floating platform in a sea of cloud, a rainbow, balloons and lanterns drifting by
kits.greeting: Nothing below but cloud.
